name: labels-p2-cold
description: Do depth-2 search labels carry to deeper search? F-L with result labels (comparator, 2 seeds) against F-L --label-depth 2 --label-result 0.5 (2 seeds), local, in a ply-2-only field of its own games (entry_ply 2, no ply-1 entries, no references, self-games), rated near argmax (tournament and self-games at softmax T 0.02: the T 0.1 ratings were confounded by each model's calibrated scale, RESULTS section 8), 15 rounds a cycle, scaled plateau with min_cycles 200, cap 600. Verdict: a final T 0.02 arena of the four champions at ply 3 with ply 2 beside it. The analyst's first experiment (theory-2 6.10 b), launched 11-11 overnight under the user's standing instruction to launch without them.
